reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code is what I'd actually check, and a counted evening sachet fits my forgetful counter habit. The empty-box guarantee lowers the risk of trying one box at the $24.99 launch price.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? I'd also want to open the lab report and see it's real before ordering.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or didn't match a batch number, I'd pass.
